policy: Human-reviewed exceptional OSM/CUATM cases. Resolved semantic classifications are recorded separately from positive-identity review. No entry changes OSM or asserts legal geometry without authoritative evidence.

cases.finding: OSM relation 6879649 has a stable Chițcani territorial identity and a long-lived administrative-boundary history. Its current «Sovetul sătesc Chițcani» semantics are retained as a de-facto administrative representation distinct from the official CUATM/legal geometry model.
next_evidence_needed: Authoritative geometry may be compared later if the project needs a legal-boundary equivalence; this is not an identity-review blocker.

sources.note: BNS 2024 census results explicitly refer to comuna Chițcani and include Merenești and Zahorna.

cases.finding: The relation has no name and no place tag in the imported metadata. A verified Hrușova parent is insufficient to identify the object because multiple distinct subordinate/allotment-type entities may exist under the same locality. No identity is assigned by inference.
